title: ferocactus recurvus subvar. greenwoodiae
intro: Ferocactus recurvus subvar. greenwoodiae, commonly known as the Green Pitaya, is a cactus species that belongs to the Ferocactus genus. The Green Pitaya is valued for its medicinal properties, which include providing relief from various health issues such as fever, pain, and inflammation, and it has been used to treat conditions such as sore throats and respiratory problems due to its expectorant properties. The bioactive constituents present in the Green Pitaya include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of the Green Pitaya include reducing inflammation, fighting off infections, and protecting the body from oxidative stress, making it a valuable plant in traditional medicine.
